📰 General

MTG Challenges Trump’s Foreign Policy, Citing Safety Concerns •

Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene stated that former President Trump’s current foreign policy stances are not aligned with the “America First” approach she previously supported. Greene expressed concern that Trump’s recent criticism of her, particularly regarding her MAGA merchandise, could pose a threat to her personal safety. The Republican Congresswoman has been a vocal defender of Trump’s policies and rhetoric. This latest disagreement highlights a growing rift within the Republican party regarding foreign policy priorities.

🌍 World

Louvre Heist Suspect’s Friends Reveal Attempts to Distance Themselves From Past •

Investigators are exploring the background of the man arrested in connection with the Louvre heist, focusing on his recent attempts to distance himself from his past. According to friends, the 39-year-old, a former prominent figure in Paris’s urban dirt bike scene, had been actively avoiding discussions about his previous activities. Witnesses describe a shift in his behavior, indicating a conscious effort to sever ties with his earlier life and associates within the subculture. Authorities are examining this information alongside other leads in the ongoing investigation.

🦅 US

Sen. John Fetterman Released from Hospital Following Facial Injury and Cardiac Event •

Senator John Fetterman was discharged from the hospital after sustaining minor injuries to his face following a fall last week. The fall triggered a ventricular fibrillation episode, requiring medical intervention. He received 20 stitches to address the facial injuries. Following his release, Fetterman shared a photo of himself with the stitches, indicating a full recovery.

💰 Business

DoorDash Driver Arrested Following Viral Customer Incident – Felony Charges Filed •

Livie Rose Henderson, the DoorDash driver who filmed a customer with pants down and sparked widespread outrage, has been arrested on felony charges. Authorities allege Henderson engaged in conduct related to the incident, though the specific charges remain undisclosed. The arrest follows a significant public outcry and legal scrutiny surrounding DoorDash’s handling of the initial complaint. Investigations are ongoing, and further details regarding the charges and evidence are expected to be released.

💻 Technology

Georgia’s Massive Junkyard: A Rusting Automotive Wonderland Spans 34 Acres •

Located north of Atlanta, Georgia houses the world’s largest classic car junkyard, encompassing a 34-acre forested compound. The site contains a vast collection of predominantly rusted American automobiles, representing decades of automotive history. The junkyard’s origins date back to the 1960s, accumulating vehicles through salvage and trade. Visitors can explore the sprawling collection, a significant repository of vintage American cars.

🎭 Entertainment

Walker Hayes Announces He’s Boycotted a Specific Restaurant Due to a Past Experience •

Country music artist Walker Hayes has stated he will no longer dine at a particular restaurant following a previous visit. Hayes explained that he experienced an uncomfortable situation during his last meal at the establishment. He detailed the incident, though specifics were not provided in the article. Hayes indicated this decision is permanent and he intends to avoid the restaurant moving forward. The article does not elaborate on the nature of the incident.

🏅 Sports

Georgia Dominates Texas in SEC Victory, Remains No. 1 in Coaches Poll •

Georgia secured a decisive 35-10 victory against Texas on Saturday at home, marking a significant statement win. The Bulldogs’ record improved to 9-1 overall and 7-1 within the SEC. Following the win, Georgia ascended in the Coaches Poll Top 25 for Week 13. The team’s performance solidified their position as one of the nation’s premier programs.

🔬 Science

Golden Comet C/2025 ATLAS Shatters into Three Fragments Near the Sun •

Comet C/2025 K1 (ATLAS), nicknamed the “golden comet,” has undergone a significant disintegration following a close approach to the Sun. Astronomers in Italy captured images revealing the comet had broken into three distinct pieces. The event occurred after the comet’s discovery in May 2025 and was likely triggered by the intense heat and solar radiation. Scientists are continuing to observe the fragments to study their composition and trajectory.

🩺 Health

Senator Expresses Alarm Over Proposed Changes to Infant Hepatitis B Vaccine Schedule •

Senator Bill Cassidy voiced significant concerns regarding a proposed modification to the recommended hepatitis B vaccine schedule for infants. The change, currently under consideration by a key advisory committee, would shift the timing of the first dose. This shift would delay the initial vaccination until after the infant receives their first dose of the DTaP vaccine. The committee’s decision could impact vaccination rates and potentially increase the risk of infection, according to Senator Cassidy.
